Decision by Matt Barge, 2026-09-25, relayed to the Claude Code session building the alpha-website-playbook QC cadence branch:

Grounding: add a grounding field to every row (complaint, source-contract, exemplar, decision, or none) with a reference; the builder sets status: advisory on any enforced row whose grounding is none, per the promotion rule in docs/observer-requirements.md. Fill it from the requirement refs and the check map where they say so; where you cannot tell, write none and list those rows in your reply.
